steps.content: Every inch of her body screams in protest. A throbbing pain radiates from her sprained ankle, forcing her into an unsteady limp as she drags herself forward.
The hidden passage she once used to flee the research institute lies somewhere ahead. If she can just find it again, she might make it out alive.
The exit looms before her, half-hidden in the shadows. But darkness creeps at the edges of her vision, pulling her under.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Gotta keep moving... This message has to get through...
As her consciousness fades, a familiar figure rushes toward her, though she can no longer tell if it's real or not.
